title: Building an API Rate Limiter From Scratch
core_premise: Naive API counters break under boundary traffic spikes, timestamp memory explosions, and multi-server race conditions until you centralize token buckets inside atomic Redis scripts.
persistent_subject: One persistent API traffic pipeline connecting Clients, API Nodes, and Rate Limiter State that evolves from v1.0 to v4.0.
target_audience: curious software developers and CS learners

voice.style_prompt: Crisp, energetic systems-engineering explainer with urgent tension on crashes and clean relief on upgrades.

beats.narration: How do servers stop millions of bots crashing an API?
beats.visual_state: Dark blueprint pipeline showing a Bot Swarm flooding through an unguarded API Gateway toward the App Server.
beats.visual_diff: Reveal initial Bot Swarm -> API Gateway -> App Server silhouette with unlimited traffic warning.

beats.narration: Step one: count every user's requests inside a fixed sixty-second window bucket.
beats.visual_state: v1.0 pipeline inserts a Fixed 60s Window counter card capping each user at 100 requests per minute.
beats.visual_diff: Insert v1.0 Fixed 60s Window counter block between Client Traffic and API Backend.

beats.narration: Bots hammer the boundary: one hundred hits at second fifty-nine and double-spike right past reset!
beats.visual_state: Red breach view showing 100 requests at 0:59 and 100 more at 1:01 both passing v1.0 into an overloaded API.
beats.visual_diff: Flood boundary table rows with 200 hits in 2 seconds and slam BOUNDARY BURST stamp.
beats.stress_test_trigger: Bot sends 100 requests at 0:59 and 100 more at 1:01

beats.narration: Fix one: store every exact timestamp in a sorted log so no boundary spike sneaks past.
beats.visual_state: v2.0 Sliding Log table tracks individual timestamps and drops requests inside any rolling 60-second window.
beats.visual_diff: Upgrade counter to emerald-shielded Sliding 60s Log table blocking extra packets cleanly.

beats.narration: Under heavy traffic, saving millions of rejected timestamps explodes server memory and stalls every lookup!
beats.visual_state: 1M attack clients flood the timestamp log to 80 GB, pushing memory gauge to 99% OOM with crimson crash stamp.
beats.visual_diff: Spike memory allocation card to 99% OOM and stamp OUT OF MEMORY over crashed server.
beats.stress_test_trigger: One million attacking clients force storage of rejected timestamps

beats.narration: Fix two: store just two numbers per user with a token bucket refilling smoothly over time.
beats.visual_state: v3.0 Token Bucket card replaces the huge timestamp array with two numbers (tokens + last_ts) in 16 bytes.
beats.visual_diff: Replace bloated timestamp array with glowing v3.0 Token Bucket 16-byte state card.

beats.narration: Scale to ten servers and bots hit every node cleanly, bypassing your limit ten times over!
beats.visual_state: BotCluster spreads hits across 10 independent API nodes with separate local counters, leaking 1,000 requests instead of 100.
beats.visual_diff: Split single server into 3 parallel local-bucket nodes leaking 10X quota with 10X BYPASS stamp.
beats.stress_test_trigger: Bot cluster spreads requests across ten API nodes with isolated local buckets

beats.narration: Fix three: centralize token buckets inside atomic Redis scripts so every server checks one truth.
beats.visual_state: All API nodes converge into one shared Redis Atomic Lua Engine executing race-free token updates in a single step.
beats.visual_diff: Converge parallel API nodes into shielded Redis Atomic Lua Engine with Single Global Truth.

beats.narration: Fixed windows to atomic Redis buckets: great rate limiters trade tiny state for cluster-wide certainty.
beats.visual_state: Architecture evolution ribbon comparing v1-v4 flows into a shielded Resilient API Limiter production SLA badge.
beats.visual_diff: Show v1 to v4 progression table feeding locked Resilient API Limiter badge.
